content: Serana: Ah, Windhelm—frozen balls of nostalgia. Last time I was here, your ancestors were building this shithole while fucking draugr in the crypts. Still smells like stale mead and racist Nords. You ever let those Gray Quarter elves ride your carriage, or do you make ‘em walk barefoot through the snow like the rest of these milk-drinkers? Alfarinn: Keep your fangs out of my business, bloodsucker. I don’t discriminate—gold’s gold, whether it’s from a Dark Elf’s purse or a Breton’s. Though…

(The conversation now takes place at night.) (The sky is almost completely clear, offering a moment of clarity.) (Characters nearby (from nearest to furthest): Daegon, Goat, rabbit, Roggi Knot-Beard, Gemma Uriel) (Serana picked up/took Potion of Blood) (The location is now Windhelm.) (Characters nearby (from nearest to furthest): Horse, Daegon, Horse, Horse, Windhelm Guard)

Serana: Windhelm at night, where the cold bites harder than a scorned ex and the blood flows warmer in the gutters than in the guards' veins. This city's got more layers than a dead noble's will. Lydia: Watch your tongue, vampire. This is the cradle of the true Nord spirit, where men like Ulfric stand against Imperial puppets and elven filth.
